atoms.text: Some plants really don’t want to be eaten! To protect themselves, they hurt people and animals that eat or touch them.

instruction.text: Select the picture of the red berries.

feedback.end: These are the berries of the yew tree. The black seed inside is very poisonous.  People and animals should leave them well alone!

instruction.text: Select the picture of the green leaves.

feedback.end: These are stinging nettles. The leaves and stems are covered in hairs that can sting your skin if you touch them. However, some people like to cook and eat them!

instruction.text: Select the picture of the shiny brown seeds.

feedback.end: These are the seeds of the horse-chestnut tree. They are covered in spikes to protect them. They are also called conkers.
